lines.line: I just, I hate this so much! I mean, every time I go pick her up at the airport, it’s-it’s so great. But at the same time I’m thinking, "Well, I’m gonna be right back there in a couple of days, dropping her off."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: So what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Nothing! There’s nothing to do! I mean, she lives there, I live here. I mean, she-she’d have to uh, move here. She should move here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I could ask her to live with me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I mean, why not! I mean, I mean why not?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Because you’ve only known her for six weeks! Okay, I’ve got a carton of milk in my fridge I’ve had a longer relationship with!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Look guys, when I’m with her it’s-it’s-it’s like she brings this-this-this great side out of me. I mean I-I-I love her, y’know?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: And I love the milk! But, I’m not gonna some British girl to move in with me! Joey, you say things now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: All right look, Ross, he’s right. Emily’s great, she’s great! But this way too soon, you’re only gonna scare her!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I don’t want to do that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: No! You don’t want to wreck it, you don’t want to go to fast!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah, no, you’re right, I know, you’re right, I’m not, I’m not gonna do it. All right, thanks guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Okay, no problem, just remember to wake us up before you go-go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: That’s too hard. Too hard!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: All right boys, last chance for the tickets!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Or I’ll give them to my new boyfriend, Joshua.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: No thank you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Wait-wait-wait-wait! Come on! Come on, let’s trade! The timing’s perfect, I just clogged the toilet!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Look, I want those basketball seats as much as you do! Okay, but we can’t leave in the small apartment after we’ve lived here! Didn’t you ever read Flowers for Algernon ?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yes! Didn’t you ever read Sports Illustrated ?! No! I didn’t read yours! But come on, we can go to the game tonight!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Look, the only way I will even consider this is if they offer a lot more than just season seats.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: It’s the Knicks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Screw the Knicks!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Whoa!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: I didn’t mean that. I just meant that the apartment is worth so much more.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Huh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: And the Knicks rule all.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yeah, the Knicks rule all!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Hey, so? Are you gonna do it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: No. No. We’re not gonna do that, y’know why? Because its not an even trade.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: All right, okay, look, what if you could keep the apartment and get the tickets?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Done!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Let me finish.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I’m talking about a bet, winner takes all.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Ooh, we could end up with nothing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Or you could end up with everything.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Ooh, I like that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: All right, so what do you say?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Oh, just do it!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Op, op, I’m convinced!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Come on man, you know I’d do it for you! Because, you’re my best friend.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: All right, but you can’t use that again for a whole year. I’m in.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: All right!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Ooh, this is so exciting! Ooh, God, what are you going to bet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh, okay, well, I think we should let Phoebe decide, because she’s the only who’s impartial, and she’s so pretty.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Okay. Umm, ooh, ooh—oh, I have a game!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Okay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: This is great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: What’s the game?! What’s the game?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh, well, it doesn’t have a name—oh, okay, Phoebeball! No, it doesn’t have a name. Umm, okay, Monica, what is your favourite thing about trees?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: They’re green?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Good! Good! Five points!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: All right, Joey, same question.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Uhh, they’re tall.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Ooh, three points. Both fine answers, but we were looking for leafy, leafy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: That’s not even a game!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: What? Shut up! We’re winning!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: You wanna finish this right now? All right, we get a deck of cards, high card wins. What do you say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Fine, let’s do it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh, I have cards!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Oh, good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah! Here! Oh no, these are the trick deck. Okay. Here yes. Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Okay, you guys uh, you guys pick first

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Okay. Four.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: That’s a low one!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yeah! Okay. Phoebe, you look, I can’t.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: What make you think I can?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Okay. Okay. Ace!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Why are you screaming and hugging?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Because we won our apartment back!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: What? Ace is high! Jack, queen, king, ace!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: No! Ace is low! Ace, two, three, four!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: I don’t know. Ooh! Ooh! Look it! Ah-ha!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: All right, cut, let’s pick again, pick again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Come on apartment! Come on apartment! Oh! I know queen is high!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Uh-huh, not as high as… It worked! King!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Yeah baby!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: But, we pick again! We pick again!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Why?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: I don’t know!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Tickets please! That’s courtside baby!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Seriously, good game though. Good game. What are they so mad about? They get the apartment back!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: No they didn’t!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Move in with me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Don’t be scared, I-I know it sounds crazy and-and people will say it’s too soon, but just-just think, think how great it will be.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Well, so, you-you’ll get a job here! I mean, I’m always hearing about uh, them foreigners coming in here and stealing American jobs; that could be you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: No, I can’t. I would, I really would, but my son is here; I can’t leave him. Isn’t—you don’t think there’s any way?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: No, no, don’t. Why don’t we?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Get married.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: No! No! I’m not! It’s-it’s-it’s perfect! I mean it’s better than you just-just moving here, ‘cause it’s us together forever, and that’s-that’s what I want.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah, I know, so what? I mean, who’s-who’s to say? Does that me we-we can’t do it? Look, huh, I was with Carol for four years before we got married and I wound up divorced from a pregnant lesbian. I mean, this, this makes sense for us. Come on! I mean, on our first date we ended up spending the whole weekend in Vermont! I mean, last night I got my ear pierced! Me! This feels right. Doesn’t it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Is that—are you saying yes? Is that yes?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yes! We’re getting married?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Come here, come here. Uh, ow! Emily, will you marry me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Damn! I thought that was going to be romantic as hell!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Those were like the best seats ever.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh yeah. Hey! Should we give these shirts to the girls? Y’know, kinda like a peace offering.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh yeah, that’s very nice. Plus, y’know they were free and they’re too small.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh. Oh, God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Hey, want a beer? WHOA!!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: I KNOW!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Open up! Open up! Open up!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: We’ll discuss it, in the morning!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: What the hell is going on?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: We took our apartment back!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: I had nothing to do with it. Okay, it was my idea, but I don’t feel good about it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: We are switching back, right now!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: No, we’re not! We’re not leaving!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Well, you’re gonna have to leave sometime, because you both have jobs, and as soon as you do, we’re switching it back! There’s nothing you can do to stop us! Right, Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I don’t want to move again!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: I don’t care, this is our apartment! And they stole—you stole it—our apartment, and we won that apartment fair and square, twice! And I am getting it back right now. I’m getting back right now!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: All right. We figured you might respond this way, so we have a backup offer.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh no-no-no, no more offers. You can’t offer anything to us!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Let us keep the apartment and…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: As a thank you, Rachel and I will kiss for one minute.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Totally worth it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: That was one good minute!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Good night.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Good night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Men are such idiots.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Yeah! Can you believe that something that stupid actually got us our apartment back?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: That’s so funny to think if you’d just done that right after the last contest, no one would have had to move at all.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Yeah, let-let-let’s pretend that’s not true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Okay, scarf’s done.

lines.line: Come on! Come on. Come on.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Okay!

lines.line: Hey!

lines.line: What-what’s going on?

lines.line: Uhh, okay, it’s uh, Emily and I, we decided to uh, to get married.

lines.line: What? Oh, are you pregnant too?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: When, when did—how, how did you…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: We, we just decided to uh, to go for it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Umm, uh, I was just telling the guys…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Yeah, I-I heard. I think it’s great! Ohh, I’m so happy for you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh, well, that’s great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yeah! Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: I can’t believe you’re getting married!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah.

lines.line: Monica and Rachel made out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Hey! Get into gear!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Are you kidding me?! Joey. Joey! Joey! Joey! Joey! Joey! Joey! Joey! Joey! Joey!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Joey. Joey. Joey. Joey! Joey!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh. Oh, did-did-did I wake you?

lines.line: Gunther, can I get another cup of coffee, please? So uh, what do you do when you’re not working here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh, okay, thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Chandler, that’s like your fourth cup of coffee!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Well, I am drinking lots of cups of coffee because I’m exhausted! Because Joey started snoring!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: He’s in a different room! He’s really that loud?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh, you should here me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: It’s not something to be proud of, okay? You have to go to a sleep clinic!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Look, I told ya, I’m not going to any clinic! I don’t have a problem, you’re the one with the problem! You should go to a "Quit being a baby and leave me alone" clinic!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yeah, they do! Quit being a baby and leave me alone! There, you’ve just had your first class!

lines.line: Y’know I used to go out with this guy that was a really light sleeper, and whenever I started to snore, he would just roll me over…

lines.line: Ohhh, yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: He would just roll me over and I would stop snoring.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Next time you snore, I’m rolling ya over!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I gotta do what I gotta do, you gotta do what you gotta do, you just do it.

lines.line: Hey, all right!

lines.line: Hey!

lines.line: Oh, the Olympics.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Have you guys picked a date yet?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Oh no, not yet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: I still cannot believe you’re engaged! Just ‘cause its happening so fast; not ‘cause you’re such a loser.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Oh. Thanks. Uh, has anyone seen Rach?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Ugh, she’s upstairs not doing the dishes! And I tell ya something! I’m not doing them this time! I don’t care if those dishes sit in the sink until they’re all covered with—I’ll do them when I get home!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah—oh! Hey listen umm, Emily found this wedding dress in London…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Already?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah, but it didn’t fit. Well, luckily there’s a store here that has one left in her size, but I’m the groom, I’m not supposed to see the dress…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: I’ll pick it up for you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh, she’s got you running errands, y’know, picking up wedding dresses… Wah-pah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Y’know, whipped! Wah-pah!

lines.line: That’s what I did. Wah-pah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: You can’t do anything!

lines.line: Hey, Mon, I was just doing the dishes!

lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh! It’s you. Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey, do uh, do you have a minute?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Yeah, yeah, I was just about to take a break anyways, so…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: So listen uh, I know you and I haven’t really had a chance to talk since uh, Emily and I decided to get married, and uh, I was just wondering how you were.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I know if you were getting married I’d feel, kinda….. y’know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Yeah. Yeah. Definitely, well it definitely took me by surprise, but I’m okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: All right, I just wanted to check.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh, that’s sweet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: You’re great. And I-I know someday this will happen for you too. You just hang in there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Uhh, hang in there?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Oh, no, I didn’t mean, uh…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I mean maybe you didn’t hear about a serious relationship called me and Joshua?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Oh, I thought you guys had just been on like four dates, I didn’t realise that had become anything, yet.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh, no-no-no, no-no-no, it has become, it has—yeah. Oh no, those were four great dates.

lines.line: Yeah. Oh, yeah. And I mean, the connection, I mean y’know, emotionally, mentally, physically…

lines.line: Wow, that’s-that’s-that’s incredible.

lines.line: I know isn’t it? It’s like I’m right there with Joshua.

lines.line: You are right there with Emily. And it’s y’know, it’s kinda like…. it’s a tie! Well, I gotta get, I gotta get back to the dishes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh yeah? Fine.

lines.line: Oh yeah, no, what’s that?

lines.line: If like the four of us could all y’know, hang out together. Uh, in fact Emily’s coming into town this weekend, why don’t you say we all have dinner? Say, Sunday night?

lines.line: That would be great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah, all right, it’s a date.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Oh my God! Ohh! Look at this one! It’s so beautiful!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah, but y’know, about have of these are gonna end up getting divorced.

lines.line: Oh, yes, umm, I’m here to pick up a dress that you have on hold.

lines.line: Emily Waltham.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: You’re the most beautiful bride I’ve ever seen.

lines.line: I am, aren’t I?

lines.line: Yes?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: All right.

lines.line: All right buddy, time to roll over. No-no! No, no-n-n-n-no!! You are going to a clinic! You’re going to a clinic, and a pyjama store!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Does she use the cups? Yes! I believe she does. Does she use the plates? Yes! I believe she does.

lines.line: Oh. Thank you. Ohhh, thank you very much. Oh, thank you for coming. Uh, just a second!

lines.line: No-no, let me in!

lines.line: This sucks! I didn’t know I had to stay up all night before I went to this stupid sleep clinic! I’m so tired!

lines.line: Yeah! Yeah, Emily always wanted to get married in this beautiful place that her parents got married, but it’s going to be torn down, so… I mean, I-I know it’s crazy, but everything up ‘til now has been so crazy, and I don’t know, this just feels right. Y’know?

lines.line: Hey! That’s the day after I stop menstruating! This isn’t mine.

lines.speaker: Rachel

lines.line: Noo! Maybe! I, I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I just, I feel, I-I just...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Y'know I can’t believe I even thought about getting back together again! We are so over!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: FINE BY ME!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: And hey! Just so you know, it’s not that common! It doesn’t happen to every guy! And it is a big deal!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: I KNEW IT!!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: You know what this is, this is us getting ready for the prom.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: You know what, you guys, we don't have to watch this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Shut up, the camera adds ten pounds.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Ahh, so how many cameras are actually on you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Lookin' good Mr. Cotter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: If you're not going then I don't want to go either.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Y'know what? I think we've seen enough, let's turn it off.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: OK, fine, well I'm not gonna watch, alright.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Okay dad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: I can't believe you did that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah, well.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: See, he's her lobster.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Nooooo. You’re really not going?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Yeah. It’s just gonna be too hard. Y’know? I mean, it’s Ross. How can I watch him get married? Y’know it’s just, it’s for the best, y’know it is, it’s… Y’know, plus, somebody’s got to stay here with Phoebe! Y’know she’s gonna be pretty big by then, and she needs someone to help her tie her shoes; drive her to the hospital in case she goes into labour.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: You don’t have a car. And your license expired.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I know. Yeah, see, there’s so much to do and I have so little time to do it in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: All right, check it out. Check this out. It says here that there’s a place you can go to rent videos of all the museums! "It’s almost as good as being there."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: It’s better! You can’t go to a museum in your underwear!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Well, You could, but... probably just the one time.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I bet we could get videos of all the sites, get a VCR in our hotel room... we'd never even have to go outside!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: If we do that, we gotta get Die Hard.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh-ho! I bet the British version is gooooood!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: That’s like the tenth time I’ve peed since I’ve been here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: That’s also like the tenth time you told us.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah, oh I’m sorry, it must be really hard to hear! I tell ya, it’s a lot easier having three babies play Bringing in the Noise, Bringing in da Funk on your bladder! I’m so sick of being pregnant! The only happiness I get is from a cup of coffee, which of course is decaf, ‘cause—Oh! I’m pregnant!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Pheebs, did…you want a cookie?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: So uh, Pheebs, honey, how are those mood swings coming?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: I haven’t really had any yet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: All right, here’s the ring.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Yes! Yes! A thousand times, yes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: So uh, any ideas for the bachelor party yet?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Whoa-whoa-whoa! Before you start handing out wedding rings and planning bachelor parties, don’t you have to decide who your best man is gonna be?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh, it’s awkward. It’s awkward. It’s awkward.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I sort’ve already asked Chandler.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: What?! He got to do it at your first wedding!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Joey, I figured you’d understand. I mean, I-I’ve known him a lot longer.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Come on Ross! Look, I-I don’t have any brothers; I’ll never get to be a best man!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: You can be the best man when I get married.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I’ll never get to be a best man!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Wait-wait, so, you get to be my best man twice and I never get to be yours at all?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh no-no-no, you—yeah, of course you get to be my best man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: What about me?! You-you just said I could!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: I’m not even getting married! Okay, this is a question for science fiction writers!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I can’t believe you’re not picking me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey, how can it not be me?!HeyHey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: I’m not even… I’m not even…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Fine, y’know what, that’s it. From now on, Joey, I want you to be my best man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yes! Shame about you man.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Stop it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: One of the babies is kicking.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: I thought that was a good thing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: It’s not kicking me, it’s kicking one of the other babies. Oh ! Don’t make me come in there!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Do you guys have like a big bowl I can borrow?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Yeah, there’s one right under the cabinet.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Why do you need it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh, we’re having a big party tomorrow night. Later!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Whoa! Hey-hey, you planning on inviting us?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Nooo, later.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Hey!! Get your ass back here, Tribbiani!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Hormones!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: What Phoebe meant to say was umm, how come you’re having a party and we’re not invited?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh, it’s Ross’s bachelor party.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Sooo?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Are you bachelors?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Nooo!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Are you strippers?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Nooo!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Then you’re not invited.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: All right fine! You’re not invited to the party we’re gonna have either.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh-whoa, what party?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Well umm…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: The baby shower for Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Baby shower. Wow! That sounds sooo like something I don’t want to do! Later!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: I can’t believe I’m gonna have a party! This is so great! A party! Yay!! I don’t know why.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: This is what I’ve got going for the party so far, liquor wise. Get a lot of liquor.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Great. Great.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Okay, now uh, in terms of the invite list, I’ve got you, me, and Chandler and I’m gonna invite Gunther ‘cause, well, we’ve been talking about this pretty loud.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: All right—oh! Listen, I know this is your party, but I’d really like to the number of museum geeks that are gonna be there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah. Tell ya what, let’s not invite any of the anthropologists, only the dinosaur dudes!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Okay! We’ll need a six-pack of Zima .

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Hey guys, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Oh, just planning my bachelor party with my best man.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Yeah, well, good luck trying to top the last one.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah, see, I don’t think it’s gonna that difficult considering this one won’t be taking place in the basement of a Pizza Hut .

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh, I’m Ross. I’m Ross. I’m too good for the Hut; I’m too good for the Hut.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Look, I gotta go pick up Ben. Everything so far sounds great Joey, just remember to keep it on the mellow side, okay? Just a couple of guys hanging out playing poker, no-no strippers or anything okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: You got it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Okay, see ya later.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: See ya. Have fun planning your mellow bachelor party.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Well, there’s gonna be strippers there. He didn’t say anything about no strippers.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: He just said, "No strippers."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh, I chose not to hear that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Look what I got! Look what I got! Look what I got! Can you believe they make these for little people?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Little village people.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Okay, look at this one. This is my favourite.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh, that is so sweet!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: I know! Phoebe is gonna love dressing them in these!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Huh. Except, Phoebe’s not gonna be the one that gets to dress them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Because she’s not gonna get to keep the babies.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh my God! We are throwing the most depressing baby shower ever!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Wait a minute! Unless, we give her all gifts she can use after she’s done being pregnant. Like-like umm, regular coffee, Tequila.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh, and somebody can get those leather pants she’s always wanted!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Oh, she’s gonna love that!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: What the hell is this?! What, did you actually thought it would make me feel better to give me stuff that I can’t use for another two months?! This sucks! All right, what’s my next present?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey listen man, about the stripper…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Good call!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Okay, a little announcement, a little announcement. I’ve decided that my best man is, my best friend Gunther!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Central Perk?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh-whoa-wait, Gunther don’t-don’t forget your shirt.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey-hey, what are those?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh, little party favours, check it out!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Wow! Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh-oh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Okay, okay, a little announcement, I just want everyone to know that the position of my best man is still open! And uh, so is the position of the bride.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Smooth man. Yeah, you got some chilie on your neck. Well, I just want to say, thanks everyone, this-this was great. And hey! See you guys Monday morning. Thanks Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh, hey, don’t forget your shirt.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Oh, thanks!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Okay, hey, museum geeks, party’s over. Okay. Wave bye-bye to the nice lady. There you go. Back to your parent’s basement. All right. Come on boys, come on out! Here you go. All right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh yeah-yeah. And I got the duck totally trained. Watch this. Stare at the wall. Hardly move. Be white.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh thanks. Thanks. It was great meetin’ ya. And listen if any of my friends gets married, or have a birthday, or a Tuesday…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh unless you uh, you wanna hang around.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yeah. I’ll let you play with my duck.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Hey, stripper!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: The stripper stole the ring!! The stripper stole the ring!! Chandler! Chandler, get up! Get up! The stripper stole the ring!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: The ring is gone!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Ugh. Just a sec, give me a minute to wake up for this—Ah-ha-ha!! You lost the ring! You’re the worst best man ever!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Dude, this isn’t funny! What am I gonna do?! I go to bed last night, everything’s cool! I wake up this morning, the stripper’s gone and the ring is gone!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: You slept with the stripper?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Of course!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Hi, guys.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Hi! Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Hi Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: I-I wanted to apologise if I—y’know seemed a tad edgy yesterday at my shower. Y’know it’s just the hormones, y’know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: No we…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Hormones.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: …hormones, yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Anyway, I just wanted to say thank you, it was just, it was so sweet.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Wow, you seem to be doing so much better. That’s great. So how-how are things going?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Good. Y’know—no-no, okay, it’s-it feels like everything’s been about me lately, so what’s happening with you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh, well, actually we were just talking about me not going to Ross’s wedding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: It just might be too hard, given the history and all that…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Wow! This reminds me of the time when I was umm, living on the street and this guy offered to buy me food if I slept with him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Well, h-how is this like that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Well, let’s see, it’s not. Really, like that. Because, you see that was an actual problem, and uh, yours is just like y’know a bunch of y’know high school crap that nobody really gives y’know…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I’m-I’m sorry, I just thought that…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Alrighty, here come the water works.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Ugh! I don’t know what I’m going to do! I called the company that sent and th-they don’t care! Then I called 9-1-1 and they laughed at me, if this isn’t an emergency, then what is?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I just wanted to thank you again for last night, what a great party! And the guys from work had a blast. Y’know, one of them had never been to a bachelor party before. Yeah! And-and another one had never been to a party before, so…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: So uh, hey, that uh, that wedding ring, huh? Man, that’s nice!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah, right!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I was uh, I was thinking I might want to pick one of those babies up for myself, I might want to get one of those…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: That ring? When my grandmother first came to this country, that ring and the clothes on her back were all she had with her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: So you might say, the ring is irreplaceable?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Oh absolutely! It has been in my family for generations, and every bride who has worn it has had a long and happy life.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: So you might say, it’s a magic ring.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yeah, the stripper stole it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: My-my ring? My-my wedding ring? The-the stripper stole my wedding ring?! H-how?! How could this all happen?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Well, I think it all started when you said, "Hey Joey, why don’t you be my best man."

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: All right-all right, fine! I-I’m gonna call the cops!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Dude, I screwed up, you don’t have to turn me in!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Not on you! On the stripper!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh, yeah, well I already did that! They said they’re gonna look into it right after they solved all the murders.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Okay, well, we’ll call the company that sent her!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I did that too! They wouldn’t give me her real name or her number. They said, "If I bothered them again they’d call the police." I said, "If you talk to the police, you tell them I’m missing a ring!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: So what, Joey? Wh-wh-what? What are you telling me? That there’s nothing we can do? Well, how could this happen?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Look Ross, I am so-so sorry. I-I-I…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Well, what if we just ah, called her, used a fake name, and had her come to my office?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh, that sounds like fun, but we’ve got a ring to find!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Here’s your tea Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: It’s so good. Oh, thanks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Good.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: I’m so glad you liked it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: What?! She made the tea!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh! No, I-I think I just had a contraction.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: You what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah, I thought I had one a couple of minutes ago, and now I know that was definitely one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Wait, you can’t have the baby here! I mean I haven’t sterilised it since the guys moved out!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Okay. It’s okay. We’re gonna be okay. Y’know what? It’s okay. I’m gonna, I’m gonna, I’m gonna boil some water and just rip up some sheets!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: No. It’s all right; it’s probably false labour. They said that, that can happen near the end, just somebody get the book.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Rachel, get the book! The book!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Okay! Okay! Here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: The Bible?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I don’t know!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: All right, okay, this is great, uh, Chandler, you get behind the desk. And-and when she comes in hopefully, she won’t recognise you because, well, why would she? Uh, okay, and then you buzz Ross and I. You be Mr. Gonzalez, and I’ll be uh, Mr. Wong.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Diverse.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: You be cool.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Where’s my ring? My dead grandmother’s wedding ring? Where is it? Where is it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Way to be cool, man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: There was a ring, in a box, on my nightstand, after you left, it was gone!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: We know you took so just-just save yourself the time and confess!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Marry me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I don’t get it! It was in my room all night! And if she didn’t take it, and I didn’t take it; and you didn’t take it, then who did? Shh! We’re trying to think!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I still don’t get how you know when it’s false labour.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Well, do you see any babies?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: How do you feel?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Okay, I guess. I mean… I don’t know, it’s just, I guess I know it’s going to be over soon.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Well, isn’t that a good thing? You said you were sick of this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: I know. It’s just y’know usually when you’re, when you’re done with the pregnant thing, y’know, then you get to do the mom thing. I’m gonna be y’know, sitting around in my leather pants, drinking Tequila.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Some moms do that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Okay that’s even sadder. Look, I know, I know what I got myself into, it’s just that now that they’re in me it’s like, it’s like I know them y’know, I mean-I mean, it’s just not gonna be easy when these little babies have to go away.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Aww, sweetie, but it’s not like you’re not gonna have anything. You’re gonna have nieces and nephews, and some ways that’s even better.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: No, really. Really, Pheebs, you’re not gonna be the one worrying about saving for college, or yelling at them when they’re bad, y’know, or deciding to put them on Ritalin when they just won’t calm down. Y’know?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: I mean, you’re the one they’re gonna come to when they wanna run away from home, and the one they talk to about sex.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: And you just get to be cool Aunt Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Cool Aunt Phoebe. I am pretty cool!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: And y’know what else, oh my God, are they gonna love you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: They are gonna love me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Thanks you guys! Again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Oh, sweetie!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: You’re the best. Thanks. Oh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Just kidding. Ahh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Got cha again, you guys are so easy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: If anything should happen to him…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Joey! The vet said it’s a simple procedure.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: So! Things can go wrong! You don’t know! What if he doesn’t make it?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: He will, Joe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yeah, but what if he doesn’t? He’s such a good duck.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I’m so worried about him, y’know?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Oh my God! Thank you! Thank you so much!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: H-h-h-how’s the duck?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Ohh, great! Oh hey, listen Ross, thanks for being so cool about this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: No, that’s all right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: No, it’s not. I mean you-you made me your best man and I totally let you down!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Hey, come on, it’s not your fault.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yeah, it is! You wouldn’t have lost the ring, right? Y’know what, Ross you were right from the start, he should be your best man.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: No, you should.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Now, don’t argue with me…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey! Hey! Hey! I get to choose my best man, and I want both you guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey, both you guys should be up there with me. I mean, you two are-are my… I mean, I’m lucky to have just one good…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Thanks man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I gotta go check something over here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: What a baby.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Total wuss!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Guys, hurry up! The flight leaves in four hours! It could take time to get a taxi! There could be traffic! The plane could leave early! When we get to London, there could be a line at customs! Come on!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Six-hour trip to London. That’s a lot of Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Passport, check! Camera, check! Traveller’s cheques, check!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Who are you saying "check" too?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Myself. Y’know for remembering to pack a thing. Yeah, you do a good thing, you get a check! My mom does it, I never realized it was weird.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah, my mom used to put her head in the oven. Well, actually, she only did it the one time. But it was pretty weird.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey! Are you ready yet?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Yep! You got the tickets?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Oh! Got ‘em right here, check!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: It’s all London, baby! Here we go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: You got your passport?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yeah, in my third drawer on my dresser. You don’t want to lose that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Ohh!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: There it is.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Okay, if you need the vacuum, it’s in my closet on the left-hand side. Ah, the garbage bags are next to the refrigerator…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Okay, okay, but Rachel’s gonna be here too, can’t I just ask her this stuff?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Yeah, okay, give that a try!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: All right! Let’s do it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Woo-hoo!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah, cheerie-o!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: London baby!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Okay, ‘cause that’s not gonna get annoying.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: London baby!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Hey, y’know what? I was wrong.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Well, we’re all here! I guess we should get going!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Ohhh, I wanna come over there and give you a hug and wish you luck on your wedding, but I don’t—can’t get up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Oh, I’ll-I’ll come hug you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Great! Yeah, could you bring me the newspaper?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh, have a great wedding!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh, hey, Chandler I wanna hug you too!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh, and great! You might as well bring me my book, it’s on the counter in your apartment.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: So, we’re off.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Have fun!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Thanks! Ugh, I can’t believe you’re not gonna be there!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh, I know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: So-so come! Why don’t you come?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: To London! Come to London. Please? It’ll mean so much to me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Yeah, well, I gotta work, I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Why-why can’t you take a couple of days off?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Because, I can’t! Ross, I told you, no. I can’t.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: This is my wedding.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: All right, y’know what? We really are late! Let’s go! Let’s go! Let’s go!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Fine. You’ll-you’ll watch it on video when we get back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Here you go Phoebe! Here you go Phobo! Phewbedo! Phaybobo.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: All right, let’s go! Bye, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Bye, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: London baby!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh, do you need a hug? You don’t have to bring me anything!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Come on! Do something!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: I am, I’m ignoring you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Okay, here! I wanna be the on camera guy. All right, first stop, Westminster Abbey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh, what the hell is that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: It’s London, baby! All right, the hotel’s here. Wait. No, we wanna go… No. I know. I’m gonna have to go into the map.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Okay, if you see a little version of me in there? Kill it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I got it! Here we go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Okay. Listen-listen, we’re not gonna have to walk this way the entire time are we?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Shhh! Man, you made me lose it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Whoa-whoa-whoa! Emily, honey, okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: What?! No! No! That’s-that’s time-out!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Sweetie, you gotta relax. Everything’s gonna be great, okay? Come on. Come on.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Chicken Kiev?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Um-hmm! Doesn’t that sound delicious at the last minute?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Yeah, y’know, but something like salmon which would be so much more elegant than the chicken. And, you wouldn’t have to worry about the salmonella. So, I can’t wait to see this place you’re getting married!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah. Yeah. Yes, this place is beautiful. Emily’s parents got married here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: It’s nice.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: It’s all right! Everything’s gonna be all right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Uh-huh, I see that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Okay, I talked to the guy with the shovel and I found out what happened.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: What? What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: They torn it down a few days early.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: All right! Westminster Abbey! Hands down, best Abbey I’ve ever seen. Hey! Okay. What do you think of the Abbey, Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: I think it’s great. It’s great. Y’know, they’re thinking of changing the name of this place.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Really? To what?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: To Put the Camera Away!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Man, you are Westminster Crabby.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh. Oh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh, honey! Don’t get up! What do you need?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh, no. Oh, nothing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Come on! I am here to take care of you! What do you need? Anything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Okay, I have a wedgie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Okay, that is all you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: So-so, what do you want for lunch?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh, I don’t know. I guess we have to eat.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah, I do. What’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I’m just bummed about the way I left things with Ross. I shouldn’t have lied to him about having to work. He seemed so mad at me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Eh, don’t be so hard on yourself. If someone I was still in love with was getting married…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Still in love with?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I’m not in love with Ross!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh. No. No. Good! Yeah, me neither.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Phoebe, I’m going to Ross’s wedding because he is my ex-boyfriend and that would be really uncomfortable. Not because, I’m still in love with him! I mean, hey, y’know, I like Ross as much as the next guy, y’know? Clearly I have feelings for him, but feelings don’t mean love! I mean, I still have loving feelings for Ross. Yeah! But, I have, I have continuing feelings of love, but that doesn’t mean that-that I’m still in love with him. Y’know? I-I have sexual feelings for him, but I do love him—Ohh! Oh my God! Oh my—why didn’t you tell me?!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: We thought you knew!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: We?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah, we all know! We talk about it all the time!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: You all know? Does Ross know?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh no, Ross doesn’t know anything.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh, I can not believe you didn’t tell me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Well, because we thought you knew!! It’s so obvious! God, that would be like telling Monica, "Hey, you like things clean."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Check this out? Huh? Yeah. That’s the stuff. What do you think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Well, I don’t have to buy that, "I’m with stupid" T-shirt anymore.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Well, I like it. Here you go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: All right, look, you’re not really gonna buy that are you? Don’t you think you’ve embarrassed me enough for one day?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh, I embarrass you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: How can I answer that when I’m pretending I don’t know you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh really? Then how come no one here is wearing them?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: All right, look, if you insist on wearing that, in public, y’know, you’re gonna spend the rest of the afternoon all by yourself.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh yeah? If you’re gonna make me choose between you and the hat? I choose the hat.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Okay, wait. All right, that’s it, okay, I’m out of here. I am not going to be embarrassed anymore!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey! I just spoke to your dad, and you know what? He seems to think we’ll be able to find a new place for the wedding.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Whoa-whoa-what? You found a place?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: She said what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Postpone it? Emily, do you think Monica realises how much our parents spent on this wedding? Do you my sister’s teeny-tiny little brain comprehends that people took time out of their lives to fly thousands of miles to be here, huh? This isn’t right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I can’t ask people to do that? Would you ask people to do that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: The only thing I understand is; postponing it is not an option. This is when we’re getting married.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: No. I’m saying it’s now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: There’s no ‘or’ in mind. What is wrong with these pants?!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: No, wait! Emily! No, wait, stop! Emily, please—

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: So, did shopping make you feel any better about Ross?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Manhattan does not have enough stores.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Well, I think I can help you get over him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: You can?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah. I just need you to bring me some photos of Ross.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Um-hmm.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: And a small piece of chocolate.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: And a glass of tepid water.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Ooh, is this one of those things where you throw it in a bag with some graveyard dirt and hang it from a north-facing tree?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Uh, only if you have the hiccups too. Yeah, the pictures are for you, the water and the chocolate is for me. I just didn’t feel like getting up. Okay, I’m gonna show you a picture of Ross. Okay? And you’re going to remember all of the bad things about him. All right? Really focus on his flaws.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I can do that. I certainly did it when we were going out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Okay. Umm, before we get started, I just wanna say for the record that I love Ross, I think he’s such a great guy. Here. Okay, now, close your eyes. And imagine that you’re with Ross okay and imagine that you’re kissing him. And you’re-you’re running your hands all over his body. And then you run your hands through his hair, but eew-oh gross it’s some kind of grease, it’s—uck! Hah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I don’t know, his uh, his hair never really bothered me that much, and y’know it was always more crunchy than it was greasy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Okay, this is going to be harder than I thought. Umm, let’s try some uh, aversion therapy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: All right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: So uh, now look at the picture…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: All right, and umm…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Okay, how do you feel now?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Well, I like you less!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh. Sorry!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: No-no-no, y’know what? I really shouldn’t have said that you were embarrassing me, I mean that really wasn’t cool. And if it makes you feel any better, I’ve had a really lousy day.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Me too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Noo!! I’ve had the best day ever! Dude, check this out!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Sh-shh-shh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Okay, so say hi to my friend and tell him that you like the hat.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh, Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: That’s Fergie baby!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: How did you? How? How?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Well, I was trying to figure out how to get to Buckingham Palace, right? So, I’m in my map and-and… Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hi. I understand you had a little talk with Emily.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Yes, I did! And you are welcome!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Am I?! And was it your idea to postpone the wedding?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: I’m gonna go to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Wait up!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Hey-hey, since you’re the ‘fix-it’ lady, here’s a pickle, what do you do when the bride says she doesn’t want to have the wedding at all?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: She said that?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Why?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I don’t know, I told her it was stupid to put off the wedding just because the hall was gone and she liked flipped out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Oh my God. You’re even dumber than I am!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Ross, how long have you been planning this wedding?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I don’t know. A month?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Emily has probably been planning it since she was five! Ever since the first time she took a pillowcase and hung it off the back of her head. That’s what we did! We dreamed about the perfect wedding, and the perfect place, with the perfect four-tiered wedding cake , with the little people on top. Thanks. But the most important part is that we had the perfect guy who understood just how important all that other stuff was.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I had no idea. And that-that pillowcase thing, I thought you guys were just doing the flying nun.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Sometimes we were.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Come on. You gotta help me figure out what to do. Okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Come on.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: That was pretty intense huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Yeah. Hey, I hope Ross didn’t think that we just went in there because we were uncomfortable being out here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: I hope he did!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Hello.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Hey, Pheebs! It’s Joey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Hey, Joey! Hey! Ooh! Ooh! I just say someone on the—that looks just like you on the subway. And I was gonna go over and say ‘hi!’ but then I figured, he doesn’t care if he looks like you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: That just cost me four bucks. But uh listen, I just called to see how the chick and the duck are doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Ohh, they’re having a great time with their Aunt Phoebe! Aunt Rachel hasn’t been helpful at all. So, do you miss me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Kinda, but I’ve just been having way too much fun.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: So you’re not homesick yet?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: No, I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: All right, the seven of us miss you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Who’s seven?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Y’know, me, Rachel, the birds, the babies…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Ahh, the babies miss me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Ooh, the pizza guy’s here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: What? You ordered pizza without me?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah. But y’know we were thinking about you, y’know we ordered the Joey Special.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Two pizzas?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yep! Okay, gotta go, talk to you later.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Wait, well, where did you get it from?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: You’ll see.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Okay? But-but imagine a lot more lights, okay? And-and y’know fewer bricks, and-and-and flowers, and candles…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: And the musicians, look, they can go over here , okay? And the chairs can face this way , and… You go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: But-but, if you don’t love this, we’ll do it in any other place at any other time. Really, it’s fine, whatever you want.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: And, I don’t know, if it starts to rain…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Ohh. And I don’t even have a date.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Do you remember where the duck food is?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah, it’s in the guys’ apartment under the sink. Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Because I’m going to London.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: What?! What do you mean you’re going to London?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Yeah, I have to tell Ross that I love him. Now honey, you take care, you don’t have those babies until I get back.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: I—Rachel, you can’t go! Ross loves Emily!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Yeah, I know, I know, I know he does. But I have to tell him how I feel! He deserves to have all the information and then he can make an informed decision.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: That’s not why you’re going! You’re going because you hope he’s gonna say, "Yeah, I love you too, Rach. Forget that British chippy."

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Ohh—Do you think he will?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: No! Because he’s in love with the British chippy! Look, Rachel, if you go, you’re just gonna mess with his head and ruin his wedding! Y’know, it’s too late! You missed you’re chance! I’m sorry, I know this must be really hard, it’s over.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Y’know what? No. It’s not over until someone says, "I do."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: I do! I do! I do! I do! Ugh, like I can really chase you. I’m carrying a litter.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Have you seen Monica?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: I’m not seeing Monica.
